scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Huh... what did she just say?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Wait... does that mean you're saying yes to dating me?

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Yes... Don’t make me say it again!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Just as an awkward silence followed the successful confession, a loud sound suddenly broke through the air.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: I’ll never forget these fireworks today♪

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: On the beach, with only the sound of waves and fireworks, {{playerName}} gently held Megumi’s hand.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Today is the day of the {{travel_destination}} trip Megumi and I had been planning for a while.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: {{playerName}}! Hurry or we’ll miss the train!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Thoughts)
scenarios.text: Since then, we've been going on trips starting with {{travel_destination}} and many more.

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: And so, yet another souvenir was added to the secretary room of the UbiLab...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Here’s some snacks from us, for everyone in the lab! Please enjoy!
